body: ## Purpose ## Content - Add `explore_lorenz_63.jl` which includes a variety of figures that accompany the blogpost - Add `Lorenz_63_example.jl` into `examples/Lorenz` , runs l63 calibration, and adds `LM` via autodiff calibration (which fails) for the blogpost - create google colab that run with two notebook scripts. - Add README.md - Relabel Lorenz... to Lorenz_96 or Lorenz_63 ## Figures produced from the new `explore_lorenz_63.jl` example: ## New figure from `lorenz_63_example.jl` ---- - [ ] I have read and checked the items on the review checklist.
title: Add an exploratory L63 example with lots of diagnostics, for upcoming blogpost
